create_backbone_subclass: create a subclass of BaseBackbone that implements the forward method for a custom neural network
implement_forward_method: implement the abstract forward method in a BaseBackbone subclass to process input tensors
initialize_backbone: initialize a BaseBackbone subclass with an optional init_cfg configuration dictionary
set_train_mode: set a BaseBackbone subclass to training mode by calling the train method with mode True
review_base_backbone: review the BaseBackbone abstract class and its forward and train methods
